page.overview:
Who is Wens Aleusis?

Wens Aleusis was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as a member of the Jedi High Council during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Aleusis was considered to be brooding by fellow Jedi, the Jedi Master attended a meeting of the Council via holoprojector where the Council members agreed that Shigar Konshi, the Padawan of the Order's Grand Master Satele Shan, was fit to take the Jedi Trials.

Wens Aleusis was mentioned in the 2010 novel The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance, written by Sean Williams as a tie-in to the then-upcoming 2011 video game Star Wars: The Old Republic by BioWare. Like many of the characters from the novel, which was written early in the game's development, Aleusis has not been referenced in any other part of the game's multimedia project.
